referenceDna.annotatedDescription: The official Quick Roofing contractor homepage homepage was inspected in paired desktop and mobile full-page captures. The page opens with a darkened roof photograph carries a compact white headline and two red inspection and company actions. It uses black-and-red horizontal service navigation with the inspection action at the top edge. The visual system relies on condensed industrial display sans with compact factual body text; surfaces include roof charcoal, white, strong red and accents include roofing red, light concrete. Imagery is roof aerials, construction close-ups, completed project photographs, and manufacturer context. The page then runs through roof image hero, three service image tiles, credential stamp strip, company explanation, construction and restoration list, storm inspection action, reviews, project gallery, manufacturer and location footer. Its service presentation is three large image-led choices for residential, commercial, and repair, followed by a more detailed service list. Mobile changes to stack the three roof choices, keep inspection visible, and turn stamps and project gallery into readable vertical groups. Transfer only the layout rhythm and decision path. Do not copy Quick Roofing identity, roof photographs, review text, manufacturer logos, warranty figures, location claims, or completed-project totals.
